  always @(posedge i_CLK_CPU, posedge i_reset) begin

      state <= S_0;
    end else begin
      state <= state;
    end

      ifetch_cancel <= 1'b0;

      ifetch_cancel <= i_mreq_n;

    if((i_reset == 1'b1)) begin
      cpu_opcode <= 8'b00000000;

        state <= S_ED_T4;

        state <= S_0;
      end

        state <= S_4D_T4;
      end

        state <= S_0;
      end

      if((cpu_opcode == 8'b00000001)) begin
        state <= S_CB_T4;
      end
      else begin
        state <= S_0;
      end
